categories.main_business_segments: Lihe Technology (Hunan) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the environmental monitoring industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of environmental monitoring systems and instruments. Its main product lines include water quality monitoring systems, air/smoke monitoring systems, and environmental monitoring information management systems. The company also provides environmental monitoring system operation services, third-party testing, and monitoring consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent innovation with core technologies in automated environmental monitoring instruments, system integration, and software development. It develops intelligent sampling products, AI-based image recognition for algae, automated virus enrichment instruments, and smart water quality testing laboratories. Production involves both in-house manufacturing of instruments and on-site system integration and commissioning, supported by advanced technologies such as AI, machine vision, digital twins, and IoT integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government departments and public institutions in environmental protection, water conservancy, municipal administration, public health, and emergency management sectors. The company also serves enterprises subject to environmental regulation. Its markets span environmental monitoring for water, air, marine, drinking water safety, disease control, and industrial pollution sources, with growing involvement in smart water services and carbon emission monitoring.
categories.geographic_coverage: Lihe Technology operates primarily across China, with significant revenue contributions from Central China, Southwest China, North China, East China, South China, Northeast China, and Northwest China regions. It has also begun expanding into overseas markets, with products and technologies applied in over ten countries and regions. The company has established seven regional business centers nationwide to support sales and operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental monitoring supply chain. It manufactures core monitoring instruments and integrates them into comprehensive monitoring systems, provides software platforms, and offers operation and maintenance services. It sources standardized and non-standardized components from suppliers but maintains control over core technology development and system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing technology innovation in environmental monitoring with a focus on intelligent, automated, and integrated monitoring systems. R&D efforts target core component localization, AI and machine learning applications, multi-scene sampling systems, smart water stations, and comprehensive data platforms. The company actively participates in national research projects and industry standards development, aiming to lead in digital transformation and ecological environment monitoring modernization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of environmental monitoring systems and instruments, software development contracts, and ongoing operation and maintenance services. The company prices products and services based on market competition, customer type, and regional factors. It also earns income from third-party testing and consulting services, as well as investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lihe Technology is positioned as a leading domestic environmental monitoring system developer and integrator with strong R&D capabilities and a comprehensive product and service portfolio. It holds significant market share in water quality monitoring and is expanding in air quality and smart water services. The company benefits from government recognition and participation in national engineering research centers, distinguishing it from competitors by its innovation and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 773.9 million, a 15.01% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 39.8 million, down 15.56% due to increased R&D and marketing expenses. Total assets stood at RMB 2.45 billion with a slight growth of 0.19%. The company maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in technology and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lihe Technology emphasizes delivering accurate, reliable, and comprehensive environmental monitoring data through advanced automated instruments and integrated systems. Its unique value lies in proprietary core technologies, high levels of instrument localization, AI-driven intelligent monitoring, and full lifecycle service capabilities. The company’s solutions support precise environmental governance, smart operation, and data-driven decision-making, differentiating it through innovation, quality, and extensive service networks.
